description: This file defines the ParameterListTable class, a custom JTable component for displaying and editing parameter lists within the ROMRaider ECU tuning application. It manages rendering, editing, tooltip display, and sorting behavior specific to parameter rows, especially those involving ECU and external data.

classes.name: ParameterListTable
classes.description: A specialized JTable for displaying parameter lists with custom rendering, editing, and sorting logic tailored for ECU tuning parameters.

methods.name: ParameterListTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the table with a custom table model, setting column reordering restrictions, and configuring column sortability.

methods.name: getCellRenderer
methods.description: Returns custom cell renderer, using a combo box renderer for certain data types.

methods.name: getCellEditor
methods.description: Returns custom cell editor, using a combo box editor for certain data types.

methods.name: getToolTipText
methods.description: Provides detailed tooltip text based on the parameter row under the cursor.

methods.name: displayComboBox
methods.description: Determines if a combo box should be used for a cell based on its data type and available converters.

methods.name: setColumnSortable
methods.description: Enables or disables sorting for a specific table column.
